subject: MSA + DPA — warranty/liability carveouts & SCCs execution plan
body:
From: Alyssa Cooper <alyssa@medsupply.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + DPA review — warranty/liability and SCCs

Hi Sean —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Legal attached our negotiated redlines for the MSA and a draft DPA (see attached). Key asks from our side:

- Warranty/liability carveouts: our GC is pushing for a higher liability cap for data incidents that affect critical supply chain systems. They propose a $50M cap or an industry carveout.
- SCCs & execution: we need confirmation you can execute the new EU SCCs path and provide a signed copy prior to pilot start.
- Subprocessors & evidence: please provide current subprocessor list, SOC2 attestation, and any operation-level export controls docs.
- Data residency: confirm processing location options for EU-only processing (we may require a VPC/private deployment).

We need a target for final MSA + DPA by 2028-06-30 to meet our procurement window. Can you review and propose a plan for the counter-redline and SCCs execution timeline?

Attachments: MedSupply_DPA_v2_redlines.docx, MedSupply_SCCs_comments.pdf

Appreciate a quick turnaround — Alyssa

---
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Cooper <alyssa@medsupply.io>
Date: 2028-06-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + DPA review — warranty/liability and SCCs

Alyssa — thanks for the materials, and for flagging timing. Copying our legal + contracts leads to help triage: Laura Bennett (Legal) and Jonas Weber (Contracts). Ben from Customer Success is also looped for the deployment/residency question.

Quick answers up front:
- We can execute the new EU SCCs. Legal will confirm the exact execution path (controller-processor wording).
- We can provide the current subprocessor list and SOC2 report; I'll attach our DPA baseline for context.
- For data residency, Dedicated/Private options are available; Ben will confirm lead time and cost implications.

Suggested next steps:
1) Laura/Jonas: review their redlines (attached) and propose a counter with a few walk-back points (warranty cap, indemnity carveouts).
2) I'll set a 30-minute sync with Alyssa + MedSupply legal for 6/23 or 6/24 — propose availability?
3) Jonas: please confirm whether a simple SCCs signature is acceptable or whether MedSupply requires a stand-alone executed addendum.

I've attached: Redwood_DPA_baseline_v3.docx (internal baseline).

Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.ai | +1 555-212-9987

--- Forwarded message to Legal/Contracts ---
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-21T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MSA + DPA review — warranty/liability and SCCs

Team — forwarding MedSupply's redlines (attached). Highlights for legal review:

1) Warranty & liability: they propose a $50M cap tied to critical system outages. Commercial is okay with a premium but requests legal guidance on precedent and acceptable carveouts for security incidents. We should propose a capped liability tied to direct damages with exceptions for gross negligence/intentional misconduct; avoid open-ended regulatory fines exposure.

2) SCCs: they insist on executed SCCs before pilot; please confirm whether signing RC/Processor Addendum is operationally feasible and whether we need to route through our EU entity or use the SCCs execution kit.

3) Subprocessors & evidence: they want SOC2 + export control docs. Laura, can legal confirm which evidence is acceptable as 'boxed pack' for procurement (SOC2 Type II, summary of subprocessor functions, DPAs with subprocessors if applicable)?

4) Data residency: Ben, please outline options and lead times for EU-only processing (Dedicated vs Private). Include cost delta estimate for a 1-year commitment.

Deadline: They want final contracts by 6/30. If we can't hit that, let's surface a realistic timeline and what open issues remain.

Thanks — Sean

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Cooper <alyssa@medsupply.io>
Date: 2028-06-22T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MSA + DPA review — warranty/liability and SCCs

Sean/Jonas/Ben/Alyssa — thanks for the materials. High-level legal view and next actions below.

Legal assessment (summary):
- Warranty & liability: $50M is outside our standard exposure. Recommend countering with a two-tier cap: (a) a breach-specific cap tied to direct third-party damages at 2x annual recurring revenue (or a negotiated flat cap, e.g., $5M–$10M depending on deal size), and (b) carveouts for regulatory fines and third-party claims limited to conspicuously listed exceptions. We should also retain our indemnity for IP claims.

- SCCs execution: we can sign the EU Commission Standard Contractual Clauses using our Processor Annex. We recommend: execute SCCs via DocuSign prior to pilot start and deliver a signed PDF to MedSupply. Jonas, please confirm which SCCs template (2021 vs. 2024) the customer attached and whether redlines require editorial fixes only.

- Subprocessor evidence pack: Acceptable evidence = SOC2 Type II PDF, subprocessor roster (name + role + country), and a summary PDF of encryption/transfer controls. We do not need to send full subprocessor DPAs unless requested. Prep materials: SOC2 report (redacted), subprocessor list, export-controls-summary.pdf.

- Data residency: Operationally, Dedicated capacity in our EU region meets the ask. Ben, provide exact provisioning lead time (estimate 4 weeks) and monthly delta vs hosted. Also confirm whether pilot can run on a Hosted with contractual commitments in place as an interim.

Action items & owners:
- Jonas: prepare a redline counter for the MSA highlighting warranty cap language and propose the two-tier/capped structure. Also confirm SCCs template and prepare execution checklist. (owner: Jonas; ETA: 2028-06-24 COB)
- Ben: Provisioning options and costs for EU Dedicated/Private, lead time and pilot interim options. (owner: Ben; ETA: 2028-06-23 EOD)
- Sean: confirm MedSupply availability for a 30-minute legal sync (I suggest 6/24 14:00 CEST / 6/24 05:00 PDT). Also coordinate commercial on pricing delta.
- Laura/Legal: Draft a short SCCs annex template for signature and the minimal evidence pack checklist to attach to procurement. (owner: Laura; ETA: 2028-06-25)

Alyssa — we'll aim to have a vendor-ready counter and SCCs execution path by the end of next week. If MedSupply's procurement timeline is firm for 6/30, Jonas and I will prioritize the MSA counter and SCCs signing prep.

Attachments referenced: Redwood_DPA_baseline_v3.docx (Redwood baseline), MedSupply_DPA_v2_redlines.docx (incoming redlines), MedSupply_SCCs_comments.pdf

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.ai | +1 555-310-4420
